title: Aureline M5 AI review publish-to-review sheet
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for a publish-to-review sheet. Names the object class, its review association, the publish mode (local draft, publish now, open in provider), the provider destination (comment, suggested patch, check annotation), whether the output is a local draft or provider-committed, and the publish / export fallback used when provider write scope is missing or a publish fails — so AI review output never publishes or merges implicitly and a local draft is never lost. Downstream the publish-to-review sheet, provider publish review, review detail, pending-review trays, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating a publish by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
